answer_1.quote: We concatenate all slots' descriptions with the input and insert a sentinel token after each description, formulating DST as a masked spans recovering task, which is similar to the pre-training objective of T5.
answer_1.outputs: Generated slot-value pairs (text) for each dialogue

answer_2.quote: We evaluate DST performance using the widely adopted Joint Goal Accuracy (JGA), which requires all slots' values are correctly predicted.
